fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/PDP/NewTruckInternalPrice.cy.js#PDP - NewTruckInternalPages [ekaPriceMumbai] [en] — Eka 3W Cargo Price in Mumbai TC-PDPI-02: Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Eka 3W Cargo Price in Mumbai
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-PDPI-02
**Title:** Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Eka 3W Cargo Price in Mumbai
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open Eka 3W Cargo Price in Mumbai, click “Check Offers”, and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real required-field validation messages for name, mobile and location are shown, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open Eka 3W Cargo Price in Mumbai
2. Click Check Offers
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify the three required-field messages
